description: Send an interactive list/menu message to a WhatsApp number.

button_text.description: Text on the list button (e.g. "View Options")

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this list message.

phone.description: WhatsApp number in international format without + (e.g. 201234567890), or the contact's phone / chat_id as listed by get_conversations_awaiting_reply (website chat, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram…)

sections.description: Array of section objects with title and rows

name: send_list
